1_no_hardcoded_clean_accuracy.detail: Real-final generator source must exist and contain no hard-coded clean accuracy.

2_no_je_to_top1_heuristic.detail: Real-final generator source must not derive Top-1 from JE.

3_no_group_mean_je_multiplier_baselines.detail: Real-final baselines must execute their implementation rather than scale Group Mean JE.

4_no_toy_latency_loop.detail: Timing must execute actual pretrained models and compression callables.

5_top1_integer_count_provenance.detail: Summary Top-1, integer count, N, per-image correct flags, required row fields, and per-architecture logits files must reconcile.

6_timing_actual_model_metadata.detail: Every raw timing row must identify actual execution, software/device configuration, and measured timing/memory fields.

8_mechanistic_studies_not_mislabeled_n10.detail: Functional geometry=100 images; attention audit=100 images; multi-block=100 perturbations.

9_confirmatory_study_not_downgraded_to_n.detail: Strict confirmatory operator-compression evaluation must remain N=1,000.

10_no_proxy_accuracy_or_latency_citation.detail: Paper-facing documents must not cite proxy consolidation accuracy/throughput/frontier CSVs as evidence.

11_no_oracle_topk_as_deployable_gate.detail: Deployable gate claims must use a calibration-frozen threshold applied per image.

12_paper_draft_gate.detail: PAPER_DRAFT must remain untouched until real outputs and all validation checks pass.
